correctness.rationale: Classical Fishburn-matrix encoding covers each n-element unlabeled interval order once. The attached script enumerates all positive row-sum weak compositions of upper-triangular matrices of weight at most eight, enforcing positive column totals, and computes the exact cover (transitive reduction). It then computes canonical nested directed 1-WL colour tuples and globally comparable colour-multiset signatures without hashes. Census 1,2,5,15,53,217,1014,5335; exactly two size-two signature collisions at n=8 and none below; n=8 round three separates all types. An independent maximal-element extension enumeration reproduces the counts and collisions, and a separate brute-force permutation checker verifies explicit witnesses and duality. The finite result is exhaustive, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: Two rounds of neighbourhood counting on the oriented Hasse diagram form a natural, inexpensive logical invariant of a poset. The classification finds its exact first loss of full isomorphism information for a fundamental family of (2+2)-free posets, completely identifies the unique dual-related obstruction classes, and establishes that an additional round separates every type at the transition order. The cutoff is the sharp first obstruction rather than an arbitrary restricted example; the result is useful as a calibrated test of expressiveness on a standard finite-structure family.
